fields.label: Dapr Application Insights Connection String
fields.help: Application Insights connection string used by Dapr to export Service to Service communication telemetry.

fields.label: Infrastructure Resource Group Name
fields.help: Name of the platform-managed resource group created for the Managed Environment to host infrastructure resources.

fields.label: Infrastructure Subnet ID
fields.help: The existing Subnet to use for the Container Apps Control Plane.

fields.label: Internal Load Balancer Enabled
fields.help: Should the Container Environment operate in Internal Load Balancing Mode? Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Log Analytics Workspace ID
fields.help: The ID for the Log Analytics Workspace to link this Container Apps Managed Environment to.

fields.label: Logs Destination
fields.help: The destination for the application logs.

fields.label: Mutual TLS Enabled
fields.help: Should mutual transport layer security (mTLS) be enabled? Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the Container Apps Managed Environment.

fields.label: Public Network Access
fields.help: The public network access setting for the Container App Environment.
